name: NAS-Bench-Compre
description: A comprehensive NAS benchmark providing precomputed architecture evaluations and customizable components to standardize and compare neural architecture search methods.
evaluation_method: accuracy (validation/test accuracy) plus resource metrics (parameters, FLOPs, latency) as configurable objectives
reputation: Well-regarded in the NAS research community as a comprehensive, standardized benchmark for comparing neural architecture search methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on neural architecture search; provides precomputed evaluations for a defined search space so results depend on the chosen search space and evaluation protocol; may not reflect performance of architectures outside the included search spaces; useful for reproducible comparisons but can saturate within specific spaces.
